opennyai_summary.decision:
2.The present petition has been preferred for the following relief/s:
(i) for issuance of appropriate writ in the nature of certiorari for quashing only that part of the Gazette of India Published on 13.5.2016 in Dally News Paper Hindustan with respect to the petitioners, whereby and whereunder the nature of land of the petitioners bearing Khata No. 30, Plot No.1082, Area 15 decimal mentioned as Mango Orchard in place of commercial, reflecting at Serial No. 123 Patna High Court CWJC No.11455 of 2016(4) dt.05-01-2026 particularly when the land In question has been purchased after payment of stamp and fee of Commercial Land mere over shops & marketing place are available adjacent to the said lend;
(ii) for issuance of an appropriate writ in the nature of Mandamus Commanding and directing the respondent to make payment the compensation of land treating as commercial land in view of law laid down in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 where by four times compensation is paid as per market value of the land;
Rekha Kumari And Anr vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168869567/
1 (iii) for issuance of any other wilt/wilts, direction directions, order/orders for which the writ petitioners shall be found entitled under the facts and circumstances of the case.
Patna High Court CWJC No.11455 of 2016(4) dt.05-01-2026 3.
This application shall be heard.
4. Since the State representing all the respondents, no notice is required.
5. Pleadings to be exchanged in six months.
6. Rule is made returnable within one year.
